about:
Founded in 1981 as a family-owned business in Baltimore, Maryland, Avalon Industries operates two distinct divisions under common ownership. The company began as a manufacturer of soft-sided carrying cases and has since expanded to include a promotional products division.

The manufacturing division produces soft-sided carrying cases, bags, totes, and molded laminate cases designed to hold and transport supplies and equipment for commercial and military applications. The second division, Avalon Promotional Products, functions as an advertising specialties distributor, supplying personalized apparel, uniforms, and branded merchandise for corporate and organizational identity programs.

Avalon’s customer base spans the U.S. defense department, first-responder agencies, public schools, municipal governments, youth sports leagues, and the broader commercial marketplace. Both divisions have supplied these sectors for several years, providing custom carrying solutions and branded promotional items tailored to each end user.

The dual-division structure allows the company to address procurement needs ranging from rugged transport cases for military gear to embroidered uniforms for local sports teams, all managed from a single family-owned operation in the Mid-Atlantic region.
